target_estimand.name: mainland floral predictor reliability ratio for classical errors-in-variables correction
target_estimand.definition: Var(latent true predictor) / Var(observed predictor) on the predictor scale used in the direct island-on-mainland response-shape analysis

external_validation_evidence.source: Hetherington-Rauth 2019 University of Toronto thesis Appendix A.1
reason_not_admissible_as_target_reliabil: validation is from a different study and measurement protocol
Southwest Pacific mixes herbarium and online/literature source measurements
family-specific floral dimensions are combined in the Southwest Pacific analysis
several repeat and inter-observer slopes depart materially from 1 and intercepts are nonzero
source does not identify a reliability distribution for either target predictor

public_source_route_audit.interpretation: The result is limited to currently available public and source-native materials. It does not assert that the measurements never existed or cannot later be supplied by an author.

reopen_conditions: recover the actual paired 30-species online-versus-herbarium validation values with trait/source mapping
recover replicate-level measurements or replicate variance on the actual Southwest Pacific predictor scale
recover a source-native repeated-measurement error model for Hendriks flower area
obtain an external validation whose measurement protocol and predictor distribution are demonstrably transportable, with uncertainty propagated
claim_boundary: The available evidence is sufficient to conclude that the reliability ratio required for formal classical-EIV admission is not identified from the current public/source-native corpus. This is a completed negative identification result, not evidence that measurement quality is poor. High external repeatability remains informative sensitivity evidence, but no assumed reliability value is substituted and the formal starting-size EIV gates stay closed.
